//go:build (linux && amd64) || (darwin && arm64)

package syscall_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"internal/gomadio"
	"internal/gomadvfd"
	"internal/poll"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const nativeDeadline = 7 * time.Second

func nativeRefusalReported(count int, operation string) bool {
	return count == 1 && operation == "socket.type-or-protocol"
}

func nativeEnable(t *testing.T) uint32 {
	t.Helper()
	if now := time.Now(); !now.Equal(time.Date(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)) {
		t.Fatalf("direct seeded initial time=%v", now)
	}
	if gomadio.NetworkEnabled() || gomadvfd.Enabled() {
		t.Fatal("fixture requires inactive legacy network and descriptor switch")
	}
	if status := gomadvfd.SetEnabled(true, []int{0, 1, 2, 4}); status != gomadvfd.OK {
		t.Fatalf("enable=%v", status)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if status := gomadvfd.SetEnabled(false, nil); status != gomadvfd.OK {
			t.Errorf("disable after cleanup=%v", status)
		}
	})
	return runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(0).HostWaiters
}

func nativeOwner(t *testing.T, fd int) {
	t.Helper()
	if !gomadvfd.Owns(fd) || gomadvfd.Token(uintptr(fd)) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("endpoint %d is not a live virtual descriptor", fd)
	}
}

func nativeNetOwner(t *testing.T, endpoint syscall.Conn) int {
	t.Helper()
	conn, err := endpoint.SyscallConn()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var fd int
	if err := conn.Control(func(raw uintptr) { fd = int(raw) }); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nativeOwner(t, fd)
	state := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(fd))
	if !state.Registered || state.Token != gomadvfd.Token(uintptr(fd)) {
		t.Fatalf("endpoint registration=%+v", state)
	}
	return fd
}

func nativeClose(t *testing.T, closer io.Closer) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := closer.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("cleanup close: %v", err)
		}
	})
}

func TestGomadNativeTCP(t *testing.T) {
	hostWaiters := nativeEnable(t)
	listener, err := net.ListenTCP("tcp4", &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nativeClose(t, listener)
	nativeNetOwner(t, listener)
	client, err := net.DialTCP("tcp4", nil, listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nativeClose(t, client)
	clientFD := nativeNetOwner(t, client)
	server, err := listener.AcceptTCP()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nativeClose(t, server)
	nativeNetOwner(t, server)
	if n, err := syscall.Write(clientFD, []byte("manual-guard")); err != nil || n != 12 {
		t.Fatalf("manual write=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
	buffer := make([]byte, 12)
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(server, buffer); err != nil || string(buffer) != "manual-guard" {
		t.Fatalf("manual read=%q,%v", buffer, err)
	}
	first, second := bytes.Repeat([]byte{'a'}, 40000), bytes.Repeat([]byte{'b'}, 30000)
	vectors := []syscall.Iovec{{Base: &first[0]}, {Base: &second[0]}}
	vectors[0].SetLen(len(first))
	vectors[1].SetLen(len(second))
	if n, err := syscall.GomadNativeWritev(clientFD, vectors); err != nil || n != 65536 {
		t.Fatalf("bounded partial writev=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
	first[0], second[0] = 'x', 'y'
	buffer = make([]byte, 65536)
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(server, buffer); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(buffer[:40000], bytes.Repeat([]byte{'a'}, 40000)) || !bytes.Equal(buffer[40000:], bytes.Repeat([]byte{'b'}, 25536)) {
		t.Fatal("writev lost cross-vector bytes or retained caller memory")
	}
	if n, err := server.Write([]byte("response")); err != nil || n != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("reverse write=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
	buffer = make([]byte, 8)
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(client, buffer); err != nil || string(buffer) != "response" {
		t.Fatalf("reverse read=%q,%v", buffer, err)
	}
	if err := client.CloseWrite(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := server.Read(make([]byte, 1)); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		t.Fatalf("half-close EOF=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
	if err := server.CloseWrite(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Read(make([]byte, 1)); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		t.Fatalf("reverse EOF=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
	unused := nativeListener(t)
	address, err := syscall.Getsockname(unused.Sysfd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := unused.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	refused := nativeFD(t)
	if err := syscall.Connect(refused.Sysfd, address); !errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) {
		t.Fatalf("unbound connect=%v", err)
	}
	if nativeRefusalReported(0, "socket.type-or-protocol") || nativeRefusalReported(1, "wrong-operation") || nativeRefusalReported(2, "socket.type-or-protocol") {
		t.Fatal("reporting predicate accepted missed, wrong or duplicate refusal")
	}
	var refusals int
	var operation string
	restore, installed := gomadio.GomadNativeInstallRefuseObserver(func(value string) {
		refusals++
		operation = value
	})
	if !installed || restore == nil || !gomadio.GomadNativeRefuseObserverActive() {
		t.Fatal("reporting observer installation failed")
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !restore() || gomadio.GomadNativeRefuseObserverActive() {
			t.Error("reporting observer did not restore the original callback state")
		}
	})
	if raw, err := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_DGRAM, syscall.IPPROTO_UDP); !errors.Is(err, syscall.EOPNOTSUPP) {
		if err == nil {
			if closeErr := syscall.Close(raw); closeErr != nil {
				t.Errorf("unexpected UDP cleanup: %v", closeErr)
			}
		}
		t.Fatalf("UDP socket refusal=%d,%v", raw, err)
	}
	if !nativeRefusalReported(refusals, operation) {
		t.Fatalf("actual backend reporting invocation count=%d operation=%q", refusals, operation)
	}
	if state := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(clientFD)); state.HostWaiters != hostWaiters {
		t.Fatalf("host waiter drift=%+v", state)
	}
	t.Log("internal-switch/guard-off; real net TCP endpoints are virtual; whole-process OS socket audit is open")
}

func nativeFD(t *testing.T) *poll.FD {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, syscall.IPPROTO_TCP)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fd := &poll.FD{Sysfd: raw, IsStream: true, ZeroReadIsEOF: true}
	initialized := false
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if fd.Sysfd < 0 {
			return
		}
		var err error
		if initialized {
			err = fd.Close()
		} else {
			err = syscall.Close(raw)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Errorf("socket cleanup: %v", err)
		}
	})
	nativeOwner(t, raw)
	if err := syscall.SetNonblock(raw, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := fd.Init("tcp", true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	initialized = true
	if !runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(raw)).Registered {
		t.Fatal("real internal/poll registration missing")
	}
	return fd
}

func nativeListener(t *testing.T) *poll.FD {
	t.Helper()
	fd := nativeFD(t)
	if err := syscall.Bind(fd.Sysfd, &syscall.SockaddrInet4{Addr: [4]byte{127, 0, 0, 1}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := syscall.Listen(fd.Sysfd, 64); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return fd
}

func nativePair(t *testing.T) (listener, client, server *poll.FD) {
	t.Helper()
	listener = nativeListener(t)
	address, err := syscall.Getsockname(listener.Sysfd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	client = nativeFD(t)
	if err := syscall.Connect(client.Sysfd, address); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _, call, err := listener.Accept()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", call, err)
	}
	server = &poll.FD{Sysfd: raw, IsStream: true, ZeroReadIsEOF: true}
	initialized := false
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if server.Sysfd < 0 {
			return
		}
		var err error
		if initialized {
			err = server.Close()
		} else {
			err = syscall.Close(raw)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Errorf("server cleanup: %v", err)
		}
	})
	nativeOwner(t, raw)
	if err := server.Init("tcp", true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	initialized = true
	return
}

func nativeParked(t *testing.T, fd int, read, write bool, host uint32) runtime.GomadNativePollState {
	t.Helper()
	var state runtime.GomadNativePollState
	for range 10000 {
		state = runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(fd))
		if state.HostWaiters != host {
			t.Fatalf("virtual operation entered host waiter accounting: %+v", state)
		}
		if state.Registered && (!read || state.ReaderCommitted) && (!write || state.WriterCommitted) {
			t.Logf("actual parked state: %+v", state)
			return state
		}
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
	t.Fatalf("actual G never committed: %+v", state)
	return state
}

func nativeDeadlineResult(t *testing.T, start time.Time, done <-chan error, host uint32) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, os.ErrDeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("deadline result=%v", err)
	}
	if elapsed := time.Since(start); elapsed != nativeDeadline {
		t.Fatalf("virtual advance=%v, want %v", elapsed, nativeDeadline)
	}
	if state := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(0); state.HostWaiters != host {
		t.Fatalf("deadline changed host waiter count: %+v", state)
	}
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		t.Fatalf("operation completed twice: %v", err)
	default:
	}
}

func TestGomadNativeAcceptDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	listener := nativeListener(t)
	start := time.Now()
	if err := listener.SetReadDeadline(start.Add(nativeDeadline)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		raw, _, _, err := listener.Accept()
		if err == nil {
			err = errors.Join(errors.New("unexpected accept success"), syscall.Close(raw))
		}
		done <- err
	}()
	nativeParked(t, listener.Sysfd, true, false, host)
	nativeDeadlineResult(t, start, done, host)
}

func TestGomadNativeReadDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	_, client, _ := nativePair(t)
	start := time.Now()
	if err := client.SetReadDeadline(start.Add(nativeDeadline)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := client.Read(make([]byte, 1)); done <- err }()
	nativeParked(t, client.Sysfd, true, false, host)
	nativeDeadlineResult(t, start, done, host)
}

func nativeFill(t *testing.T, fd *poll.FD) {
	t.Helper()
	for i := range 64 {
		if n, err := syscall.Write(fd.Sysfd, []byte{byte(i)}); err != nil || n != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("queue chunk %d=%d,%v", i, n, err)
		}
	}
	if n, err := syscall.Write(fd.Sysfd, []byte{64}); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, syscall.EAGAIN) {
		t.Fatalf("queue bound=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
}

func TestGomadNativeReadyWake(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	start := time.Now()
	listener := nativeListener(t)
	address, err := syscall.Getsockname(listener.Sysfd)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	accepted := make(chan int, 1)
	acceptError := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { raw, _, _, err := listener.Accept(); accepted <- raw; acceptError <- err }()
	nativeParked(t, listener.Sysfd, true, false, host)
	connector := nativeFD(t)
	if err := syscall.Connect(connector.Sysfd, address); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw := <-accepted
	if err := <-acceptError; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := syscall.Close(raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, client, server := nativePair(t)
	readResult := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		data := make([]byte, 1)
		n, err := server.Read(data)
		if err == nil && (n != 1 || data[0] != 99) {
			err = errors.New("read-ready payload mismatch")
		}
		readResult <- err
	}()
	state := nativeParked(t, server.Sysfd, true, false, host)
	for range 2 {
		runtime.GomadNativePublish(uintptr(server.Sysfd), state.Token, 'r')
	}
	nativeParked(t, server.Sysfd, true, false, host)
	if n, err := client.Write([]byte{99}); err != nil || n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("ready source write=%d,%v", n, err)
	}
	if err := <-readResult; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	nativeFill(t, client)
	writeResult := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		n, err := client.Write([]byte{64})
		if err == nil && n != 1 {
			err = errors.New("capacity-ready write count mismatch")
		}
		writeResult <- err
	}()
	nativeParked(t, client.Sysfd, false, true, host)
	data := make([]byte, 1)
	if n, err := server.Read(data); err != nil || n != 1 || data[0] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("first queue dequeue=%d,%v,%v", n, err, data)
	}
	if err := <-writeResult; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for expected := 1; expected <= 64; expected++ {
		if n, err := server.Read(data); err != nil || n != 1 || data[0] != byte(expected) {
			t.Fatalf("FIFO chunk %d=%d,%v,%v", expected, n, err, data)
		}
	}
	if time.Since(start) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("readiness wake consumed future logical time")
	}
	if state := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(0); state.HostWaiters != host {
		t.Fatalf("ready wake changed host waiters: %+v", state)
	}
}

func TestGomadNativeWriteDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	_, client, _ := nativePair(t)
	nativeFill(t, client)
	start := time.Now()
	if err := client.SetWriteDeadline(start.Add(nativeDeadline)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := client.Write([]byte{64}); done <- err }()
	nativeParked(t, client.Sysfd, false, true, host)
	nativeDeadlineResult(t, start, done, host)
}

func TestGomadNativeSimultaneousDeadlines(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	_, client, _ := nativePair(t)
	nativeFill(t, client)
	start := time.Now()
	if err := client.SetDeadline(start.Add(nativeDeadline)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	read, write := make(chan error, 1), make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := client.Read(make([]byte, 1)); read <- err }()
	go func() { _, err := client.Write([]byte{64}); write <- err }()
	nativeParked(t, client.Sysfd, true, true, host)
	nativeDeadlineResult(t, start, read, host)
	nativeDeadlineResult(t, start, write, host)
}

func TestGomadNativeCloseParkedRead(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	_, client, _ := nativePair(t)
	start := time.Now()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := client.Read(make([]byte, 1)); done <- err }()
	raw := client.Sysfd
	nativeParked(t, raw, true, false, host)
	if err := client.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, poll.ErrNetClosing) {
		t.Fatalf("close result=%v", err)
	}
	if state := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(raw)); state.Registered || state.HostWaiters != host {
		t.Fatalf("closed registration leaked: %+v", state)
	}
	if time.Since(start) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("close used a future logical event")
	}
}

func TestGomadNativePollDescReuse(t *testing.T) {
	host := nativeEnable(t)
	_, _, old := nativePair(t)
	oldFD := old.Sysfd
	previous := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(oldFD))
	if err := old.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var target *poll.FD
	read := true
	for range 32 {
		listener, client, server := nativePair(t)
		for _, candidate := range []*poll.FD{listener, client, server} {
			state := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(candidate.Sysfd))
			if state.Descriptor == previous.Descriptor {
				if state.Sequence == previous.Sequence || state.Token == previous.Token {
					t.Fatalf("physical reuse lacked fresh identity: old=%+v new=%+v", previous, state)
				}
				target, read = candidate, candidate != listener
				t.Logf("physical pollDesc reuse: old=%+v new=%+v", previous, state)
				break
			}
		}
		if target != nil {
			break
		}
		for _, candidate := range []*poll.FD{server, client, listener} {
			if err := candidate.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	if target == nil {
		t.Skip("INCONCLUSIVE: physical pollDesc reuse was not observed within 32 allocations")
	}
	start := time.Now()
	if err := target.SetReadDeadline(start.Add(nativeDeadline)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		if read {
			_, err := target.Read(make([]byte, 1))
			done <- err
		} else {
			raw, _, _, err := target.Accept()
			if err == nil {
				err = errors.Join(errors.New("unexpected reuse accept"), syscall.Close(raw))
			}
			done <- err
		}
	}()
	before := nativeParked(t, target.Sysfd, true, false, host)
	for range 2 {
		runtime.GomadNativePublish(uintptr(oldFD), previous.Token, 'r')
		runtime.GomadNativePublish(uintptr(target.Sysfd), previous.Token, 'r')
	}
	for range 32 {
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
	after := runtime.GomadNativePollSnapshot(uintptr(target.Sysfd))
	if !after.ReaderCommitted || after.Reader != before.Reader || after.HostWaiters != host {
		t.Fatalf("stale notification reached new owner: before=%+v after=%+v", before, after)
	}
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		t.Fatalf("stale notification completed operation: %v", err)
	default:
	}
	nativeDeadlineResult(t, start, done, host)
}
